findings.evidence: Suspected overstrong global Sobolev-lift summary. For d=1 and smooth compactly supported data with nonzero mean, the Poisson extension has finite gradient energy but infinite L2(H) norm, so it is not in W^{1,2}(H). The repaired item distinguishes local cutoff traces from the global trace under its exact L2 condition; the page summary omits this qualification.

The sentence attributes AC-requiring ACL and change-of-variables interfaces collectively to the cusp and jump examples. The cusp proof does not invoke ACL and uses linear change of variables under Countable Choice, as its published supplier explicitly states. The jump instead carries AC through the sharp trace theorem.
